trace.question: List the patient ID, sex and birthday of patient with LDH beyond normal range.
trace.evidence: LDH beyond normal range refers to LDH > '500';

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH > 500

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH > 500
trace.answer: The query returned 103 patients with abnormal LDH levels. The first 20 are listed above, showing their IDs, sex, and birthdays, with IDs such as 27654 (F, 1936-03-25) and 57266 (M, 1923-07-25).
